reason: PURE. The first thing I saw was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR on the front, and that is the one thing that gets a zero-review brand past my filter. I would scan it, check the lab name and the magnesium and heavy metals numbers, and if it holds up I would try one box of the bisglycinate for the gym bag and car, not the complex.
objection: No reviews and no NSF or USP seal, so the lab report is only the brand's own word until I see the real report. If the QR leads to a vague or fake-looking PDF, I am out.
would_change_my_mind: A real batch report from a lab I can look up, showing the magnesium number matches the label. Some verified reviews would also help me reorder.
